scope: Audit current PRC processing rules, identify gaps and draft additions. Runtime code and active rules were unchanged in this turn.

adversarial_checks.boundary: Accepted counterexamples show host limits using authored responses. They do not measure real LLM accuracy.

already_present: Original proposal plus explicitly designated project document/JSON imports
Protected-source exclusion and exact quotation checks
Full source-unit checklist IDs and candidate/review hash binding
Fresh extraction and independent review calls
Separate project_rules.json with scoped text and usage annotations
Failure artifacts retained; no active scientific acceptance inferred

gaps.finding: An obligation can cite a source unit whose coverage row says NO_REQUIREMENT with no linked items.
gaps.recommendation: Validate reverse relationships from every obligation evidence span to its source coverage and final publication map; reject contradictory coverage.

gaps.finding: task_rules.project_rules validates pack integrity but does not compare the supplied project context with the pack's reviewed context.
gaps.recommendation: Apply an explicit reviewed project/task binding at every entry point. Keep projected branch contracts usable through their parent reference; do not compare a deliberately smaller branch as if it were a complete main.
gaps.verification: Real synthetic published-pack probe: different drug rejected by context_with_rules, accepted by task_rules.project_rules. Normal clinical dispatch has additional guards; no claim that production runs were misbound.

gaps.finding: PRC008 allows informational non-obligation unknowns, but validation rejects all UNRESOLVED items and source rows.
gaps.recommendation: Add explicit issue materiality, needed_at, impact, blocking scope and rationale; retain strict stops for unresolved obligation meaning, authority and conflicts.
gaps.verification: Informational unresolved probe was REJECTED despite INFO severity.

gaps.finding: The earlier recommendation duplicated compression's responsibility by adding project-fact and project-assumption extraction to Project Rules Agent. The user assigns this identification to compression; the rule agent needs upstream references and non-rule source coverage instead.
gaps.recommendation: Specify and verify compression's fact/assumption handoff, then reuse its relevant context references during requirement extraction. Do not create a second fact/assumption catalogue or mislabel project facts as literature facts. Route source-supported omissions or inconsistencies back to compression; extract explicit assumption-use obligations as requirements linked to that upstream assumption.
gaps.verification: Historical probes rejected both labels in the rule-agent schema. Under the corrected ownership decision, rejection alone is not a defect and does not justify duplicate extraction; the revised handoff and source-coverage behavior still need implementation and verification.
gaps.superseded_recommendation: Add and audit the missing categories; only supported PROJECT_REQUIREMENT items publish. Correct the empty-obligation fixture that currently labels project facts as literature facts.

gaps.finding: Exact quotes and valid source roles do not establish that the quotation entails the entire rule or that a source obligation was not misclassified away.
gaps.recommendation: Re-check final organized rules in both directions against original materials; use human-labeled adversarial blind evaluation. Keep deterministic checks distinct from semantic-model capability.
gaps.verification: Unsupported-meaning and obligation-to-fact probes with authored all-PASS reviews were ACCEPTED. No real-model error rate was measured.

gaps.finding: Source roles do not encode draft/adopted/withdrawn/superseded status, and there is no explicit rule replacement registry.
gaps.recommendation: Introduce reviewed adoption status and explicit predecessor, affected scope and activation relations. User confirmed explicit replacement; newer dates alone do not override.
gaps.verification: Source inspection; existing tests check allowed roles and protected files, not amendment lifecycle.

gaps.finding: Routing filters stage/task/source IDs but does not evaluate biological scope or rule conditions; unknown array sentinels can be treated as names.
gaps.recommendation: Distinguish stage routing from task applicability; add typed applicability states, explicit unknowns and later metadata qualification. Do not broadcast unknown rules or silently exclude them.
gaps.verification: Unknown sentinel probe ACCEPTED; biological qualification is already documented as a consumer responsibility.

gaps.finding: scope.window is reused as source_window, while usage.check_at is metadata without a downstream execution record.
gaps.recommendation: Separate observation_window, required_phase, trigger and deadline. Define a version-bound applicability/compliance record now; connect actual enforcement later as the user confirmed.
gaps.verification: Source inspection; no claim of executed compliance checks.

gaps.finding: The independent reviewer checks candidate items before the host merges them and appends conditions, scope text and usage metadata.
gaps.recommendation: Organize the staged rule package before independent review so final content is directly reviewed. Run deterministic publication validation afterward; any substantive post-review change requires new review.
gaps.verification: Source inspection. Existing assembly is deterministic; this is the user's newly confirmed final-package re-check requirement.

gaps.finding: Verification compares frozen processing rules with the current constant and rebuilds requests with current shared governance, so policy updates can make intact historical packages unverifiable.
gaps.recommendation: Separate verification under the frozen historical contract from eligibility under the currently authorized project/rule contract. Never silently approve stale rules for a new task.
gaps.verification: PRC and governance drift probes both REJECTED the historical artifacts; silent stale reuse was not observed.

gaps.finding: The review request supplies objective/study and existing_rules, but not relevant main checks, data-use declarations or uncertainty fields. New-format existing_rules is empty.
gaps.recommendation: Supply a source-bound relevant context slice and compare the final rule package against it. If an adopted clarification changes the effective context, report required context revision instead of publishing contradictory meanings.
gaps.verification: Source inspection; objective unchanged/exact-duplication checks exist, but are not a full context consistency review.

gaps.finding: PRC003 is a short preservation sentence; this agent does not receive the full approved 13-category scientific detail profile used by compression.
gaps.recommendation: Provide the complete applicable preservation details through a shared scientific-meaning profile with a module-appropriate scope; do not import compression-only access instructions wholesale.
gaps.verification: Instruction/schema inspection; no live evaluation of current preservation performance.

implementation_order.phase: Align compression ownership and the rule-agent context handoff
Meet final-package review and version requirements

implementation_order.note: Contract drafted now; do not activate downstream enforcement in this audit.

regression_cases: Compression identifies and preserves project facts and assumptions; Project Rules Agent reuses the reviewed context without duplicate extraction.
A project fact must not become a mandatory rule or be mislabeled as a literature fact to satisfy the rule-agent schema.
An explicit obligation to use an assumption links to that upstream assumption without treating it as an observed parameter.
Source-supported missing or inconsistent facts/assumptions produce a compression correction request rather than a silent main.json edit.
Paper use of two compartments does not mandate two compartments here.
A genuine quote with a fabricated threshold fails semantic review.
Every obligation maps back to supporting source units; NO_REQUIREMENT contradictions fail.
An unrelated unknown is informational; unknown permission affecting publication blocks.
Later validation evidence is not demanded during animal data preparation.
An explicit authorized replacement changes only its declared scope; a date alone never replaces.
A rule pack for another project is rejected by every consumer entry point.
Conditions, negations, AND/OR and free/total basis survive consolidation.
Organized output changed after review requires new review.
Historical artifacts remain verifiable under their frozen contract while current eligibility is checked separately.
Missing applicability or compliance records cannot count as PASS.
decisions_confirmed_this_turn: Explicit scoped replacement with prior versions retained
Downstream check contract now; execution integration later
Re-check and re-validate the final organized rules
Compression owns PROJECT_FACT and PROJECT_ASSUMPTION identification; Project Rules Agent reuses and checks the context for requirement extraction
